en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a river harbor with several paddle steamers and barges moored along a quay. The foreground shows a steamboat named "BOHEMIA" with passengers on deck. On the right side run rail tracks with wagons, small buildings, people, carts and industrial facilities with chimneys in the background. The text at the top identifies the location as Riesa on the Elbe River and labels the steamship landing place.
